**Research resources are in preparation**

This page reserves space for a future curated QCA bibliography and related research resources. No bibliography has yet been approved for publication.

## Resources under consideration

- Introductory QCA literature
- Methodological debates and developments
- Empirical applications
- Software and teaching materials
- Reproduction materials and public data
- External resources on Zotero, OSF, and GitHub

Classification, search, CSV, BibTeX, and Zotero integration will be considered after the scope, copyright status, and publication format have been agreed.
